definition: To give reasons for a belief or position.
example: The authors argue that cheaper housing would help workers remain in the city.

fr.definition: Présenter des raisons pour défendre une opinion.

de.definition: Gründe für eine Meinung anführen.

es.definition: Dar razones para defender una opinión.

pt.definition: Apresentar razões para defender uma opinião.

definition: An opinion about a subject.
example: Her view is that the policy sounds fair but would be difficult to enforce.

fr.definition: Une opinion sur un sujet.

de.definition: Eine persönliche Meinung zu einer Frage.

es.definition: Una idea personal sobre un asunto.

pt.definition: Uma ideia pessoal sobre um assunto.

definition: Facts or information that show whether a claim is true.
example: The survey provides evidence that younger voters prefer candidates with detailed climate plans.

fr.definition: Fait qui permet de vérifier une affirmation.

de.definition: Tatsache oder Angabe, die eine Aussage stützt.

es.definition: Hecho que permite comprobar una afirmación.

pt.definition: Facto que permite comprovar uma afirmação.

definition: A clear difference between two things.
example: The contrast between the two studies suggests that context matters more than age.

fr.definition: Différence marquée entre deux choses.

de.definition: Deutlicher Unterschied zwischen zwei Dingen.

es.definition: Diferencia clara entre dos cosas.

pt.definition: Diferença clara entre duas coisas.

definition: To write or speak about a subject in detail.
example: The paper discusses how public transport can reduce inequality between neighbourhoods.

fr.definition: Examiner un sujet en détail.

de.definition: Ein Thema ausführlich erörtern.

es.definition: Examinar un asunto en detalle.

pt.definition: Analisar um assunto em detalhe.

definition: To provide reasons or facts that strengthen a claim.
example: Recent figures support the claim that remote work has improved staff retention.

fr.definition: Renforcer une affirmation avec des faits ou des raisons.

de.definition: Eine Aussage mit Fakten oder Gründen stärken.

es.definition: Reforzar una afirmación con hechos o razones.

pt.definition: Reforçar uma afirmação com factos ou razões.

definition: To show that something may be true or suitable.
example: These results suggest that short breaks may improve concentration during long lectures.

fr.definition: Montrer qu’une chose est peut-être vraie ou adaptée.

de.definition: Darauf hindeuten, dass etwas wahr oder passend sein könnte.

es.definition: Mostrar que algo puede ser cierto o adecuado.

pt.definition: Mostrar que algo pode ser verdadeiro ou adequado.

definition: An important idea or detail in an argument.
example: A key point in the report is that small changes can have lasting effects.

fr.definition: Idée importante dans un raisonnement.

de.definition: Wichtiger Gedanke in einer Argumentation.

es.definition: Idea importante dentro de un razonamiento.

pt.definition: Ideia importante num raciocínio.

definition: The subject that a text or discussion is about.
example: The essay introduces the topic clearly before comparing three different policy approaches.

fr.definition: Thème dont parle un texte ou une discussion.

de.definition: Gegenstand eines Textes oder Gesprächs.

es.definition: Asunto del que trata un texto o una conversación.

pt.definition: Assunto de que trata um texto ou uma conversa.

definition: A problem or question that needs attention.
example: The central issue is whether the new rules protect residents without raising rents.

fr.definition: Question importante à examiner ou à résoudre.

de.definition: Wichtige Frage, die geprüft oder geklärt werden muss.

es.definition: Pregunta importante que hay que examinar o resolver.

pt.definition: Pergunta importante que é preciso analisar ou resolver.

definition: A reason why something happens.
example: The main cause of the decline was reduced funding, not a lack of public interest.

fr.definition: Ce qui explique pourquoi un événement se produit.

de.definition: Der Grund, warum etwas geschieht.

es.definition: La razón por la que ocurre algo.

pt.definition: A razão pela qual algo acontece.

definition: A change or result produced by an action or event.
example: The effect of the new policy was visible within a few months.

fr.definition: Un résultat ou un changement produit par une action.

de.definition: Ein Ergebnis oder eine Veränderung, die durch etwas entsteht.

es.definition: Un resultado o cambio producido por una acción.

pt.definition: Um resultado ou uma mudança produzida por uma ação.

definition: The final part of an argument, where main points are brought together.
example: Her conclusion links the evidence to the claim made at the start of the essay.

fr.definition: La partie finale qui rassemble les idées principales d'un raisonnement.

de.definition: Der letzte Teil, der die wichtigsten Gedanken eines Arguments zusammenführt.

es.definition: La parte final que reúne las ideas principales de un razonamiento.

pt.definition: A parte final que reúne as ideias principais de um argumento.

definition: To present a topic or idea for the first time.
example: The first paragraph will introduce the debate and define its key terms.

fr.definition: Présenter un sujet ou une idée pour la première fois.

de.definition: Ein Thema oder eine Idee zum ersten Mal vorstellen.

es.definition: Presentar un tema o una idea por primera vez.

pt.definition: Apresentar um tema ou uma ideia pela primeira vez.

definition: To give the main points in a shorter form.
example: At the end, summarize the evidence before stating your own position.

fr.definition: Présenter les idées principales sous une forme plus courte.

de.definition: Die wichtigsten Punkte in kürzerer Form wiedergeben.

es.definition: Expresar las ideas principales de forma más breve.

pt.definition: Apresentar as ideias principais de forma mais breve.

definition: Used to show that one fact does not prevent another.
example: Although the sample was small, the results still support the broader claim.

fr.definition: Introduit une idée qui contraste avec la proposition principale.

de.definition: Leitet einen Gegensatz zwischen zwei Aussagen ein.

es.definition: Introduce una idea que contrasta con la afirmación principal.

pt.definition: Introduz uma ideia que contrasta com a afirmação principal.

definition: Used to add a statement that contrasts with what came before.
example: The proposal seems practical; however, its long-term costs remain uncertain.

fr.definition: Sert à introduire une idée qui s'oppose à ce qui précède.

de.definition: Leitet einen Gedanken ein, der dem Vorherigen widerspricht.

es.definition: Introduce una idea que contrasta con lo dicho antes.

pt.definition: Introduz uma ideia que contrasta com o que foi dito antes.

definition: Used to show that something follows as a result.
example: The evidence is incomplete; therefore, the findings should be treated with caution.

fr.definition: Indique qu'une idée découle de ce qui précède.

de.definition: Zeigt, dass etwas aus dem Vorherigen folgt.

es.definition: Indica que algo se deduce de lo anterior.

pt.definition: Indica que algo resulta do que foi dito antes.

definition: Used to say that one thing is chosen in place of another.
example: Several studies found no clear link; instead, they pointed to other factors.

fr.definition: Indique qu'une chose remplace une autre.

de.definition: Zeigt, dass eine Sache eine andere ersetzt.

es.definition: Indica que una cosa sustituye a otra.

pt.definition: Indica que uma coisa substitui outra.

definition: Used to show that two things happen at the same time or differ.
example: While the first study tracks costs, the second examines effects on access.

fr.definition: Relie deux idées simultanées ou opposées.

de.definition: Verbindet zwei Dinge, die gleichzeitig geschehen oder sich unterscheiden.

es.definition: Relaciona dos hechos simultáneos o contrapuestos.

pt.definition: Relaciona dois factos simultâneos ou contrastantes.

definition: Used to introduce what you personally think about a subject.
example: In my opinion, the policy needs more evidence before the committee approves it.

fr.definition: Sert à introduire ce que l’on pense personnellement d’un sujet.

de.definition: Leitet ein, was man persönlich über ein Thema denkt.

es.definition: Se usa para introducir lo que uno piensa personalmente sobre un tema.

pt.definition: Usa-se para introduzir aquilo que se pensa pessoalmente sobre um assunto.

definition: Used to introduce one side of an issue before presenting another.
example: On the one hand, the proposal could save money; on the other, it may reduce access.

fr.definition: Sert à présenter un aspect d’une question avant d’en présenter un autre.

de.definition: Leitet einen Aspekt einer Frage ein, bevor ein anderer genannt wird.

es.definition: Se usa para presentar un aspecto de una cuestión antes de mencionar otro.

pt.definition: Usa-se para apresentar um aspeto de uma questão antes de mencionar outro.

definition: Used to introduce a different or contrasting side of an issue.
example: The plan is expensive; on the other hand, it could prevent larger costs later.

fr.definition: Sert à présenter un autre aspect, souvent différent ou opposé, d’une question.

de.definition: Leitet einen anderen, oft gegensätzlichen Aspekt einer Frage ein.

es.definition: Se usa para presentar otro aspecto, a menudo distinto u opuesto, de una cuestión.

pt.definition: Usa-se para apresentar outro aspeto, muitas vezes diferente ou oposto, de uma questão.

definition: Used to introduce the final point or summary of an argument.
example: In conclusion, the results support further research but do not prove the theory.

fr.definition: Sert à introduire le dernier point ou le résumé d’un raisonnement.

de.definition: Leitet den letzten Punkt oder die Zusammenfassung einer Argumentation ein.

es.definition: Se usa para introducir el último punto o el resumen de un razonamiento.

pt.definition: Usa-se para introduzir o último ponto ou o resumo de um raciocínio.

definition: To have the same view as someone or accept that an idea is right.
example: I agree with the report’s conclusion, although its evidence could be stronger.

fr.definition: Avoir la même opinion que quelqu’un ou accepter qu’une idée est juste.

de.definition: Dieselbe Meinung haben oder eine Aussage als richtig akzeptieren.

es.definition: Tener la misma opinión que alguien o aceptar que una idea es correcta.

pt.definition: Ter a mesma opinião que alguém ou aceitar que uma ideia está correta.

definition: A set of reasons used to support an idea or persuade someone.
example: Her argument links the rise in housing costs to a shortage of new homes.

fr.definition: Ensemble de raisons qui soutiennent une idée ou cherchent à convaincre.

de.definition: Ein Grund, der eine Aussage stützt oder jemanden überzeugen soll.

es.definition: Conjunto de razones que apoya una idea o busca convencer.

pt.definition: Conjunto de razões que apoia uma ideia ou procura convencer.

definition: A statement that someone says is true, often without giving proof.
example: The claim that remote work reduces productivity needs stronger evidence.

fr.definition: Énoncé présenté comme vrai, parfois sans preuve.

de.definition: Aussage, die als wahr dargestellt wird, oft ohne Beweis.

es.definition: Enunciado que se presenta como verdadero, a veces sin pruebas.

pt.definition: Enunciado apresentado como verdadeiro, por vezes sem provas.

definition: To study something carefully by examining its parts and how they relate.
example: The essay analyzes how economic pressure shapes voters’ choices.

fr.definition: Étudier soigneusement quelque chose en examinant ses éléments et leurs liens.

de.definition: Etwas genau untersuchen und seine Teile sowie deren Beziehungen betrachten.

es.definition: Estudiar algo con cuidado, examinando sus partes y cómo se relacionan.

pt.definition: Estudar algo com atenção, examinando as suas partes e relações.

definition: To judge the nature, quality, or importance of something.
example: Before proposing reforms, the report assesses the scale of the problem.

fr.definition: Juger la nature, la qualité ou l’importance de quelque chose.

de.definition: Die Art, Qualität oder Bedeutung von etwas einschätzen.

es.definition: Juzgar la naturaleza, la calidad o la importancia de algo.

pt.definition: Julgar a natureza, a qualidade ou a importância de algo.

definition: To decide how good or successful something is, often using clear standards.
example: The researchers evaluate each policy by comparing its costs with its benefits.

fr.definition: Déterminer la qualité ou la réussite de quelque chose selon des critères.

de.definition: Anhand klarer Maßstäbe entscheiden, wie gut oder erfolgreich etwas ist.

es.definition: Decidir cómo de bueno o eficaz es algo según ciertos criterios.

pt.definition: Decidir quão bom ou eficaz algo é, com base em critérios.

definition: To show that something exists, is true, or is likely to happen.
example: The survey results indicate a growing preference for smaller, local shops.

fr.definition: Montrer qu’une chose existe, est vraie ou risque de se produire.

de.definition: Zeigen, dass etwas besteht, wahr ist oder wahrscheinlich geschieht.

es.definition: Mostrar que algo existe, es cierto o probablemente ocurrirá.

pt.definition: Mostrar que algo existe, é verdadeiro ou provavelmente acontecerá.

definition: To suggest an idea without saying it directly.
example: By calling the results incomplete, the author implies that further research is needed.

fr.definition: Suggérer une idée sans l’exprimer directement.

de.definition: Eine Idee nahelegen, ohne sie direkt auszusprechen.

es.definition: Sugerir una idea sin expresarla directamente.

pt.definition: Sugerir uma ideia sem a expressar diretamente.

definition: To give special importance or attention to something.
example: The conclusion emphasizes that prevention is cheaper than treating the damage later.

fr.definition: Accorder une importance particulière à quelque chose.

de.definition: Etwas besonders wichtig erscheinen lassen oder hervorheben.

es.definition: Dar especial importancia o atención a algo.

pt.definition: Dar especial importância ou atenção a algo.

definition: To draw attention to an important part or feature.
example: The comparison highlights the gap between the policy’s aims and its results.

fr.definition: Attirer l’attention sur un élément ou un aspect important.

de.definition: Die Aufmerksamkeit auf einen wichtigen Teil oder Aspekt lenken.

es.definition: Llamar la atención sobre una parte o característica importante.

pt.definition: Chamar a atenção para uma parte ou característica importante.

definition: To show clearly that something is true, often by using facts or examples.
example: The data demonstrate that targeted support improves students’ chances of success.

fr.definition: Montrer clairement qu’une chose est vraie, souvent à l’aide de faits.

de.definition: Mit Fakten oder Beispielen klar zeigen, dass etwas wahr ist.

es.definition: Mostrar claramente que algo es cierto, a menudo con datos o ejemplos.

pt.definition: Mostrar claramente que algo é verdadeiro, muitas vezes com dados ou exemplos.

definition: To make an idea clearer by giving examples or showing how it works.
example: The case study illustrates how local policies can affect wider economic trends.

fr.definition: Rendre une idée plus claire par des exemples ou des images.

de.definition: Einen Gedanken durch Beispiele oder Bilder verständlicher machen.

es.definition: Aclarar una idea mediante ejemplos o imágenes.

pt.definition: Tornar uma ideia mais clara através de exemplos ou imagens.

definition: To show that something is true or exists, often through evidence.
example: The researchers established a clear link between sleep quality and memory.

fr.definition: Montrer qu’un fait est vrai ou qu’un lien existe.

de.definition: Mit Belegen zeigen, dass etwas wahr ist oder besteht.

es.definition: Probar que algo es cierto o que existe.

pt.definition: Provar que algo é verdadeiro ou existe.

definition: To give good reasons for a claim, choice, or action.
example: The authors justify their conclusion by comparing results from three separate studies.

fr.definition: Donner de bonnes raisons pour une affirmation, un choix ou une action.

de.definition: Gute Gründe für eine Behauptung, Entscheidung oder Handlung anführen.

es.definition: Dar buenas razones para una afirmación, decisión o acción.

pt.definition: Dar boas razões para uma afirmação, decisão ou ação.

definition: To accept or admit that something is true or exists.
example: The report acknowledges that its data may not represent the whole population.

fr.definition: Admettre ou déclarer qu’un fait est vrai.

de.definition: Zugeben oder erklären, dass etwas wahr ist.

es.definition: Admitir o declarar que algo es cierto.

pt.definition: Admitir ou declarar que algo é verdade.

definition: To accept that a fact or quality is real or important.
example: Any serious analysis must recognize the limits of the available evidence.

fr.definition: Admettre qu’un fait ou une qualité est réel ou important.

de.definition: Akzeptieren, dass eine Tatsache oder Eigenschaft real oder wichtig ist.

es.definition: Admitir que un hecho o una cualidad es real o importante.

pt.definition: Admitir que um facto ou uma qualidade é real ou importante.

definition: To mention or discuss someone or something in speech or writing.
example: In the final section, the author refers to earlier studies on urban growth.

fr.definition: Mentionner ou évoquer quelqu’un ou quelque chose.

de.definition: Jemanden oder etwas erwähnen oder inhaltlich aufgreifen.

es.definition: Mencionar o tratar a alguien o algo.

pt.definition: Mencionar ou abordar alguém ou alguma coisa.

definition: To draw attention to a fact or detail.
example: The critic points out that the article overlooks several important counterarguments.

fr.definition: Attirer l’attention sur un fait ou un détail.

de.definition: Die Aufmerksamkeit auf eine Tatsache oder Einzelheit lenken.

es.definition: Llamar la atención sobre un hecho o un detalle.

pt.definition: Chamar a atenção para um facto ou pormenor.

definition: To consider something when making a decision or forming an opinion.
example: The comparison takes into account differences in age, income, and education.

fr.definition: Prendre un élément en considération lors d’une décision ou d’un jugement.

de.definition: Etwas bei einer Entscheidung oder Einschätzung beachten.

es.definition: Considerar algo al tomar una decisión o formar una opinión.

pt.definition: Considerar algo ao tomar uma decisão ou formar uma opinião.

definition: An idea accepted as true without enough proof.
example: The argument depends on the assumption that all participants had equal access to information.

fr.definition: Idée considérée comme vraie sans preuve suffisante.

de.definition: Eine Idee, die ohne ausreichende Beweise als wahr gilt.

es.definition: Idea que se considera cierta sin pruebas suficientes.

pt.definition: Ideia considerada verdadeira sem provas suficientes.

definition: A way of dealing with a problem or doing a task.
example: This approach allows researchers to compare responses across different age groups.

fr.definition: Manière de traiter un problème ou d’accomplir une tâche.

de.definition: Eine Art, ein Problem anzugehen oder eine Aufgabe zu bearbeiten.

es.definition: Manera de tratar un problema o realizar una tarea.

pt.definition: Maneira de tratar um problema ou realizar uma tarefa.

definition: One thing that helps cause a result or affects a situation.
example: Cost is an important factor when students decide whether to study abroad.

fr.definition: Élément qui influence un résultat ou une situation.

de.definition: Einflussgröße, die ein Ergebnis oder eine Situation mitbestimmt.

es.definition: Elemento que influye en un resultado o una situación.

pt.definition: Elemento que influencia um resultado ou uma situação.

definition: A particular way of seeing or understanding a subject.
example: From a historical perspective, the policy reflects fears that were common at the time.

fr.definition: Manière particulière de voir ou de comprendre un sujet.

de.definition: Eine bestimmte Art, ein Thema zu sehen oder zu verstehen.

es.definition: Manera particular de ver o entender un tema.

pt.definition: Maneira particular de ver ou compreender um tema.

definition: Closely connected to the subject being discussed.
example: Please include only evidence relevant to the question being discussed.

fr.definition: En rapport direct avec le sujet traité.

de.definition: In direktem Zusammenhang mit dem behandelten Thema.

es.definition: Relacionado directamente con el tema tratado.

pt.definition: Relacionado diretamente com o tema em análise.

definition: Large or important enough to affect a situation or deserve attention.
example: The survey found a significant difference between students who revised and those who did not.

fr.definition: Assez important pour avoir un effet ou mériter l’attention.

de.definition: Wichtig oder groß genug, um beachtet zu werden oder etwas zu bewirken.

es.definition: Lo bastante importante para tener un efecto o merecer atención.

pt.definition: Suficientemente importante para ter efeito ou merecer atenção.

definition: As a result of something just mentioned.
example: The sample was too small; consequently, the results cannot support a broad conclusion.

fr.definition: Donc, comme résultat de ce qui vient d’être dit.

de.definition: Als Ergebnis dessen, was gerade gesagt wurde.

es.definition: Como resultado de lo que se acaba de mencionar.

pt.definition: Como resultado daquilo que acabou de ser referido.

definition: Used to add another point or piece of information.
example: The plan is affordable; furthermore, it can be introduced without disrupting classes.

fr.definition: Sert à ajouter un autre point ou une autre information.

de.definition: Fügt einen weiteren Punkt oder eine weitere Information hinzu.

es.definition: Sirve para añadir otro punto u otra información.

pt.definition: Serve para acrescentar outro ponto ou outra informação.

definition: Used to add information that supports or strengthens a point.
example: The method is inexpensive; moreover, it produces results that are easy to compare.

fr.definition: Sert à ajouter une information qui renforce une idée.

de.definition: Fügt eine Information hinzu, die einen Gedanken unterstützt.

es.definition: Añade información que apoya o refuerza una idea.

pt.definition: Acrescenta informação que apoia ou reforça uma ideia.

definition: Used to show that something remains true despite what was just said.
example: The evidence is limited; nevertheless, it offers a useful starting point for further research.

fr.definition: Indique qu’un fait reste vrai malgré ce qui vient d’être dit.

de.definition: Zeigt, dass etwas trotz des zuvor Gesagten weiterhin gilt.

es.definition: Indica que algo sigue siendo cierto pese a lo dicho.

pt.definition: Indica que algo continua a ser verdade apesar do que foi dito.

definition: Used to show that two facts or situations are different.
example: Some researchers prioritise speed, whereas others focus on accuracy and repeatability.

fr.definition: Sert à montrer que deux faits ou situations sont différents.

de.definition: Zeigt, dass zwei Tatsachen oder Situationen unterschiedlich sind.

es.definition: Sirve para mostrar que dos hechos o situaciones son distintos.

pt.definition: Serve para mostrar que dois factos ou situações são diferentes.

definition: Used to show a clear difference between two things.
example: Urban areas gained population; in contrast, several rural regions experienced steady decline.

fr.definition: Sert à montrer une différence nette entre deux éléments.

de.definition: Zeigt einen deutlichen Unterschied zwischen zwei Dingen.

es.definition: Sirve para mostrar una diferencia clara entre dos elementos.

pt.definition: Serve para mostrar uma diferença clara entre dois elementos.

definition: Used to explain the same idea in a clearer or different way.
example: In other words, the policy rewards speed rather than careful reasoning.

fr.definition: Sert à reformuler une idée plus clairement.

de.definition: Damit wird derselbe Gedanke anders erklärt.

es.definition: Se usa para expresar la misma idea de otra manera.

pt.definition: Usa-se para expressar a mesma ideia de outra forma.

definition: Used to introduce one example of something.
example: For instance, several participants changed their answers after seeing the data.

fr.definition: Sert à présenter un exemple.

de.definition: Leitet ein Beispiel ein.

es.definition: Introduce un ejemplo.

pt.definition: Introduz um exemplo.

definition: Considering all parts or facts together.
example: Overall, the proposal is persuasive, although its costs remain uncertain.

fr.definition: En considérant tous les éléments ensemble.

de.definition: Unter Berücksichtigung aller Teile oder Fakten.

es.definition: Teniendo en cuenta todos los elementos.

pt.definition: Tendo em conta todos os elementos.

definition: Used to point to one thing more than others.
example: The study examines rural schools, in particular those with limited funding.

fr.definition: Sert à désigner un élément plus précisément.

de.definition: Hebt eine Sache gegenüber anderen hervor.

es.definition: Señala algo de forma más concreta.

pt.definition: Destaca algo de forma mais específica.

definition: Used to show that the opposite of what was said is true.
example: The figures do not show declining demand; on the contrary, sales increased.

fr.definition: Sert à montrer que l'idée opposée est vraie.

de.definition: Zeigt, dass das Gegenteil der Aussage zutrifft.

es.definition: Indica que ocurre lo opuesto a lo dicho.

pt.definition: Indica que acontece o oposto do que foi dito.

definition: Used to say that something happens even though another thing might prevent it.
example: Despite several objections, the committee approved the revised research plan.

fr.definition: Indique qu'une chose se produit sans être empêchée par une autre.

de.definition: Zeigt, dass etwas geschieht, obwohl etwas dagegen spricht.

es.definition: Indica que algo ocurre aunque exista un obstáculo.

pt.definition: Indica que algo acontece mesmo havendo um obstáculo.

definition: Used to show what happened because of something else.
example: The sample was too small; as a result, the findings remain tentative.

fr.definition: Indique ce qui découle d'un fait.

de.definition: Zeigt, was aufgrund einer Sache geschieht.

es.definition: Indica lo que ocurre a causa de algo.

pt.definition: Indica o que acontece em consequência de algo.

definition: Because of a particular cause or reason.
example: The delay was due to missing records, not a lack of staff.

fr.definition: Indique la cause d'une situation.

de.definition: Gibt den Grund für etwas an.

es.definition: Indica la causa de una situación.

pt.definition: Indica a causa de uma situação.

definition: Used to add another fact or point.
example: The method reduces errors; in addition, it makes results easier to compare.

fr.definition: Sert à ajouter une information.

de.definition: Fügt einen weiteren Punkt hinzu.

es.definition: Sirve para añadir otro dato o argumento.

pt.definition: Serve para acrescentar outro dado ou argumento.

definition: To support a statement with facts or evidence.
example: The survey results substantiate her claim that flexible hours improve staff retention.

fr.definition: Appuyer une affirmation par des éléments de preuve.

de.definition: Eine Aussage mit Beweisen oder Fakten stützen.

es.definition: Apoyar una afirmación con pruebas o razones.

pt.definition: Apoiar uma afirmação com provas ou razões.

definition: To gradually weaken the strength or credibility of something.
example: Repeated errors in the dataset undermine confidence in the study’s conclusions.

fr.definition: Affaiblir progressivement la solidité ou la crédibilité de quelque chose.

de.definition: Die Stärke oder Glaubwürdigkeit von etwas nach und nach schwächen.

es.definition: Debilitar poco a poco la fuerza o credibilidad de algo.

pt.definition: Enfraquecer gradualmente a força ou credibilidade de algo.

definition: To admit that a point or fact is true, often unwillingly.
example: Although she disagreed with the policy, she conceded that it had reduced costs.

fr.definition: Reconnaître qu’un point avancé par autrui est juste.

de.definition: Zugeben, dass ein Einwand oder eine Tatsache stimmt.

es.definition: Reconocer que un argumento o un hecho es válido.

pt.definition: Reconhecer que um argumento ou facto é válido.

definition: To answer an argument by presenting reasons against it.
example: The author rebuts this objection by showing that the comparison uses outdated figures.

fr.definition: Répondre à un argument en présentant des raisons contraires.

de.definition: Ein Argument mit Gegenbelegen oder Gründen zurückweisen.

es.definition: Responder a un argumento con razones en contra.

pt.definition: Responder a um argumento apresentando razões contrárias.

definition: To show with evidence that a statement is false.
example: Further experiments refuted the claim that the treatment caused the observed decline.

fr.definition: Montrer, à l’aide de preuves, qu’une affirmation est fausse.

de.definition: Mit Beweisen zeigen, dass eine Aussage falsch ist.

es.definition: Demostrar con pruebas que una afirmación es falsa.

pt.definition: Demonstrar com provas que uma afirmação é falsa.

definition: To argue that an idea or opinion is true.
example: Several researchers contend that the benefits outweigh the risks in the long term.

fr.definition: Défendre une opinion ou une idée comme étant vraie.

de.definition: Eine Meinung vertreten und sagen, dass sie wahr ist.

es.definition: Defender una opinión o idea como verdadera.

pt.definition: Defender uma opinião ou ideia como verdadeira.

definition: To state firmly that something is true.
example: The report asserts that access to public transport shapes employment opportunities.

fr.definition: Présenter une idée comme vraie, souvent avec assurance.

de.definition: Etwas bestimmt als wahr darstellen.

es.definition: Presentar una idea como cierta, a menudo con seguridad.

pt.definition: Apresentar uma ideia como verdadeira, muitas vezes com segurança.

definition: To limit or clarify a statement so it is not too general.
example: The conclusion should be qualified because the sample excluded rural households.

fr.definition: Limiter ou préciser une affirmation pour éviter une généralisation.

de.definition: Eine Aussage begrenzen oder genauer machen.

es.definition: Limitar o precisar una afirmación para evitar que sea demasiado general.

pt.definition: Introduzir uma condição ou reserva numa afirmação.

definition: To respond to an argument or action with an opposing one.
example: To counter this argument, the paper compares outcomes across three regions.

fr.definition: S’opposer à un argument ou à une action par une réponse.

de.definition: Einem Argument etwas als Gegenargument entgegensetzen.

es.definition: Oponerse a un argumento o efecto con una respuesta.

pt.definition: Apresentar um argumento ou uma resposta em oposição a outro.

definition: To reach a conclusion from clues or facts.
example: From the interviews, we can infer that trust developed gradually rather than immediately.

fr.definition: Tirer une conclusion à partir d’indices ou de faits.

de.definition: Aus Hinweisen oder Tatsachen einen Schluss ziehen.

es.definition: Sacar una conclusión a partir de indicios o hechos.

pt.definition: Tirar uma conclusão a partir de indícios ou factos.

definition: See or explain how one thing is different from another.
example: The analysis distinguishes short-term gains from the long-term costs of the policy.

fr.definition: Voir ou expliquer en quoi une chose diffère d’une autre.

de.definition: Erkennen oder erklären, worin sich eine Sache von einer anderen unterscheidet.

es.definition: Ver o explicar en qué se diferencia una cosa de otra.

pt.definition: Ver ou explicar em que difere uma coisa de outra.

definition: Take or produce something using information, material, or ideas from a source.
example: The authors derive their main conclusion from a comparison of the two studies.

fr.definition: Obtenir ou construire quelque chose à partir d’une source.

de.definition: Etwas aus Informationen oder einer Quelle gewinnen.

es.definition: Obtener algo a partir de una fuente o de unos datos.

pt.definition: Conseguir algo a partir de uma fonte ou de dados.

definition: Explain why something happened or why it is the way it is.
example: The author accounts for the sudden drop by pointing to changes in the survey sample.

fr.definition: Donner les raisons d’un fait ou d’une situation.

de.definition: Die Gründe für ein Ereignis oder einen Zustand nennen.

es.definition: Dar las razones de un hecho o de una situación.

pt.definition: Indicar as razões de um acontecimento ou de uma situação.

definition: Come from a particular cause or source.
example: Many disagreements stem from different assumptions about what counts as reliable evidence.

fr.definition: Avoir une cause ou une origine particulière.

de.definition: Eine bestimmte Ursache oder einen bestimmten Ursprung haben.

es.definition: Tener una causa o un origen concreto.

pt.definition: Ter uma causa ou uma origem específica.

definition: Necessarily involve something as a result or part.
example: A shift to online teaching may entail extra costs for students with limited internet access.

fr.definition: Avoir quelque chose comme conséquence nécessaire.

de.definition: Etwas als notwendige Folge oder als Teil einschließen.

es.definition: Incluir algo como consecuencia necesaria o como parte.

pt.definition: Incluir algo como consequência necessária ou como parte.

definition: An idea accepted as true for an argument or discussion.
example: The argument rests on the premise that all participants had equal access to information.

fr.definition: Idée admise comme vraie pour construire un raisonnement.

de.definition: Eine als wahr angenommene Idee, auf der ein Argument beruht.

es.definition: Idea aceptada como cierta para construir un razonamiento.

pt.definition: Ideia aceite como verdadeira para desenvolver um argumento.

definition: A possible effect or result of an action or idea.
example: One implication of the findings is that current testing methods may overlook quieter students.

fr.definition: Effet ou résultat possible d’une action ou d’une idée.

de.definition: Mögliche Wirkung oder mögliches Ergebnis einer Handlung oder Idee.

es.definition: Posible efecto o resultado de una acción o de una idea.

pt.definition: Possível efeito ou resultado de uma ação ou de uma ideia.

definition: A link between two things that change or appear together.
example: The study found a correlation between screen time and sleep loss, but could not prove causation.

fr.definition: Lien entre deux éléments qui évoluent ou apparaissent ensemble.

de.definition: Ein Zusammenhang zwischen zwei Dingen, die sich gemeinsam verändern oder auftreten.

es.definition: Relación entre dos elementos que cambian o aparecen juntos.

pt.definition: Relação entre dois elementos que mudam ou aparecem em conjunto.

definition: The quality of being sound, fair, or based on good reasoning.
example: The small sample size raises doubts about the validity of the study's conclusions.

fr.definition: Caractère solide ou acceptable d’un raisonnement ou d’une preuve.

de.definition: Eigenschaft, stichhaltig oder auf gute Belege gestützt zu sein.

es.definition: Cualidad de ser sólido o de basarse en buenos razonamientos.

pt.definition: Qualidade de ser sólido ou de se basear em bons argumentos.

definition: The quality of staying similar and not containing conflicting ideas.
example: The reviewer questioned the consistency of the results across different age groups.

fr.definition: Qualité d’un raisonnement dont les idées ne se contredisent pas.

de.definition: Eigenschaft, bei der sich Aussagen nicht widersprechen.

es.definition: Cualidad de un razonamiento cuyas ideas no se contradicen.

pt.definition: Qualidade de um raciocínio cujas ideias não se contradizem.

definition: Clear and logically connected, so its parts make sense together.
example: The report presents a coherent argument linking the policy’s goals to its likely effects.

fr.definition: Clair et organisé de façon à ce que les idées s’enchaînent logiquement.

de.definition: Klar und logisch aufgebaut, sodass die einzelnen Teile zusammenpassen.

es.definition: Claro y ordenado, de modo que las ideas se relacionan lógicamente.

pt.definition: Claro e organizado de modo que as ideias se relacionem logicamente.

definition: Based on facts rather than personal feelings or opinions.
example: The report uses objective measures rather than relying on participants’ personal impressions.

fr.definition: Fondé sur des faits plutôt que sur des sentiments ou des opinions personnelles.

de.definition: Auf Fakten gestützt und nicht von persönlichen Gefühlen oder Meinungen bestimmt.

es.definition: Basado en hechos y no en sentimientos u opiniones personales.

pt.definition: Baseado em factos, e não em sentimentos ou opiniões pessoais.

definition: Based on personal feelings or opinions rather than facts alone.
example: Because the ratings were subjective, the researchers checked them against independent observations.

fr.definition: Fondé sur des sentiments ou des opinions personnelles plutôt que sur des faits seuls.

de.definition: Von persönlichen Gefühlen oder Meinungen statt nur von Fakten bestimmt.

es.definition: Basado en sentimientos u opiniones personales, y no solo en hechos.

pt.definition: Baseado em sentimentos ou opiniões pessoais, e não apenas em factos.

definition: Unfairly favoring one side, group, or point of view.
example: The survey was biased because it asked only supporters of the proposed policy.

fr.definition: Qui favorise injustement un point de vue ou un groupe.

de.definition: So gestaltet, dass eine Seite oder Gruppe unfair bevorzugt wird.

es.definition: Que favorece injustamente un punto de vista o grupo.

pt.definition: Que favorece injustamente um ponto de vista ou grupo.

definition: Large or important enough to have a noticeable effect.
example: The revised model produced a substantial improvement across several independent measures.

fr.definition: Assez important ou grand pour avoir un effet notable.

de.definition: Groß oder wichtig genug, um eine deutliche Wirkung zu haben.

es.definition: Lo bastante grande o importante como para tener un efecto notable.

pt.definition: Suficientemente grande ou importante para ter um efeito notório.

definition: Showing small but important differences or details.
example: Her nuanced account recognizes both the policy’s benefits and its unequal effects.

fr.definition: Qui montre des différences ou des détails subtils mais importants.

de.definition: Mit wichtigen Unterschieden und Einzelheiten sorgfältig dargestellt.

es.definition: Que muestra diferencias o detalles sutiles pero importantes.

pt.definition: Que revela diferenças ou pormenores subtis, mas importantes.

definition: Not yet certain or final, and open to change.
example: The authors offer a tentative explanation, noting that further trials may change it.

fr.definition: Qui n’est pas encore définitif et peut être modifié.

de.definition: Noch nicht endgültig und möglicherweise veränderbar.

es.definition: Que aún no es definitivo y puede cambiar.

pt.definition: Que ainda não é definitivo e pode ser alterado.

definition: Used to say that something can be supported with good reasons, even if not everyone agrees.
example: Arguably, the policy reduced costs, although its effects on service quality remain unclear.

fr.definition: D’une manière que l’on peut défendre avec des arguments raisonnables.

de.definition: Auf eine Weise, die sich mit guten Gründen vertreten lässt.

es.definition: De una manera que puede defenderse con argumentos razonables.

pt.definition: De uma forma que se pode defender com argumentos razoáveis.

definition: Probably, based on what is known or expected.
example: The missing responses were presumably lost during data transfer, but the team could not confirm this.

fr.definition: Probablement, d’après ce que l’on sait ou ce que l’on prévoit.

de.definition: Wahrscheinlich, nach dem, was bekannt ist oder erwartet wird.

es.definition: Probablemente, según lo que se sabe o se espera.

pt.definition: Provavelmente, com base no que se sabe ou se espera.

definition: Used to introduce a result or conclusion that follows from what was just said.
example: The survey included only ten people; hence, its findings should be treated with caution.

fr.definition: Introduit une conclusion qui découle de ce qui vient d’être dit.

de.definition: Leitet eine Schlussfolgerung aus dem zuvor Gesagten ein.

es.definition: Introduce una conclusión que se deduce de lo dicho antes.

pt.definition: Introduz uma conclusão que decorre do que foi dito.

definition: As a result of that.
example: The revised survey included rural households, thereby giving the findings broader relevance.

fr.definition: Comme résultat de cela.

de.definition: Als Folge davon.

es.definition: Como resultado de eso.

pt.definition: Como resultado disso.

definition: In the opposite way or situation.
example: Urban residents favored faster transit; conversely, rural participants prioritized reliable road access.

fr.definition: Dans le sens opposé.

de.definition: In der entgegengesetzten Weise.

es.definition: En sentido contrario.

pt.definition: No sentido oposto.

definition: Because of that; in a way that fits the situation.
example: Early results revealed a regional bias; accordingly, we expanded the sample.

fr.definition: Comme résultat de cela.

de.definition: Als Folge davon.

es.definition: Como resultado de ello.

pt.definition: Como resultado disso.

definition: Despite what was just said or done.
example: The policy raised costs; nonetheless, the long-term gains may justify the initial expense.

fr.definition: Malgré cela.

de.definition: Trotzdem; trotz dessen.

es.definition: A pesar de eso.

pt.definition: Apesar disso.

definition: Despite something.
example: Notwithstanding its modest size, the study identifies a clear gap in existing research.

fr.definition: Sans être empêché par quelque chose.

de.definition: Ungeachtet einer Sache.

es.definition: Sin que algo lo impida.

pt.definition: Sem que algo o impeça.

definition: Although; used before a short phrase that adds a limitation.
example: The proposal is promising, albeit costly, and would require careful monitoring during implementation.

fr.definition: Même si quelque chose est vrai.

de.definition: Auch wenn etwas zutrifft.

es.definition: Incluso si algo es cierto.

pt.definition: Mesmo que algo seja verdade.

definition: To the degree that something is true.
example: The comparison is useful insofar as both groups faced similar conditions at the start.

fr.definition: Selon le degré auquel quelque chose est vrai.

de.definition: In dem Maß, in dem etwas zutrifft.

es.definition: Según el grado en que algo es cierto.

pt.definition: Segundo o grau em que algo é verdade.

definition: Because of something; when considering it.
example: In light of newly released data, the committee postponed its decision until next month.

fr.definition: En tenant compte de quelque chose.

de.definition: Wenn man etwas berücksichtigt.

es.definition: Teniendo en cuenta algo.

pt.definition: Tendo algo em consideração.

definition: After considering all sides.
example: On balance, the evidence supports gradual reform rather than an immediate and complete overhaul.

fr.definition: Après avoir examiné tous les aspects.

de.definition: Nach Betrachtung aller Seiten.

es.definition: Tras considerar todos los aspectos.

pt.definition: Depois de considerar todos os aspetos.

definition: Partly, but not completely.
example: To some extent, the disagreement reflects different assumptions about what counts as successful learning.

fr.definition: En partie, mais pas entièrement.

de.definition: Teilweise, aber nicht vollständig.

es.definition: En parte, pero no del todo.

pt.definition: Em parte, mas não completamente.

definition: To make a statement seem more likely by providing supporting evidence.
example: Two independent witnesses corroborated the driver's account of the accident.

fr.definition: Confirmer une affirmation par des éléments supplémentaires.

de.definition: Durch zusätzliche Belege als wahr oder wahrscheinlich erscheinen lassen.

es.definition: Confirmar una afirmación con pruebas adicionales.

pt.definition: Confirmar uma afirmação com provas adicionais.

definition: To estimate what may happen in a wider case from known facts.
example: Because the survey covered only two cities, we should not extrapolate its results nationwide.

fr.definition: Estimer une situation plus large à partir de données connues.

de.definition: Aus bekannten Daten auf einen größeren Zusammenhang schließen.

es.definition: Calcular una situación más amplia a partir de datos conocidos.

pt.definition: Estimar uma situação mais ampla com base em dados conhecidos.

definition: To put forward an idea as a basis for discussion or reasoning.
example: The author posits that public trust declines when officials avoid explaining their decisions.

fr.definition: Avancer une idée comme point de départ d’un raisonnement.

de.definition: Eine Aussage als Grundlage einer Überlegung aufstellen.

es.definition: Proponer una idea como base de un razonamiento.

pt.definition: Apresentar uma ideia como base de um raciocínio.

definition: To place two things side by side so their differences or links become clear.
example: The essay juxtaposes rural and urban responses to reveal how access shapes opportunity.

fr.definition: Placer côte à côte pour faire ressortir des différences ou des liens.

de.definition: Nebeneinanderstellen, um Unterschiede oder Zusammenhänge sichtbar zu machen.

es.definition: Colocar una cosa junto a otra para destacar diferencias o vínculos.

pt.definition: Colocar lado a lado para destacar diferenças ou relações.

definition: To treat two different things as if they were the same.
example: Critics conflate correlation with causation, although the two concepts require different evidence.

fr.definition: Considérer à tort deux choses différentes comme identiques.

de.definition: Zwei verschiedene Dinge fälschlich als gleich behandeln.

es.definition: Tratar equivocadamente dos cosas diferentes como si fueran iguales.

pt.definition: Tratar erradamente duas coisas diferentes como se fossem iguais.

definition: To understand a statement or action in the wrong way.
example: Readers may misconstrue the qualification as support for a policy the author rejects.

fr.definition: Comprendre une déclaration ou une action de façon incorrecte.

de.definition: Eine Aussage oder Handlung falsch verstehen.

es.definition: Entender una declaración o una acción de forma equivocada.

pt.definition: Compreender uma declaração ou ação de forma errada.

definition: To assume something is true before it has been shown.
example: This argument presupposes that all voters have equal access to reliable information.

fr.definition: Tenir quelque chose pour vrai avant de l’avoir démontré.

de.definition: Etwas als wahr annehmen, bevor es bewiesen wurde.

es.definition: Dar algo por cierto antes de haberlo demostrado.

pt.definition: Considerar algo verdadeiro antes de o ter demonstrado.

definition: A warning that limits or qualifies a claim.
example: One caveat is that the sample excludes people who lack internet access.

fr.definition: Une précision qui limite ou nuance une affirmation.

de.definition: Ein Hinweis, der eine Aussage einschränkt oder näher bestimmt.

es.definition: Una precisión que limita o matiza una afirmación.

pt.definition: Uma observação que limita ou esclarece uma afirmação.

definition: A mistake in reasoning that makes an argument unreliable.
example: Assuming that popularity proves effectiveness is a fallacy in this policy debate.

fr.definition: Une erreur logique qui rend un argument peu fiable.

de.definition: Ein Denkfehler, der ein Argument unzuverlässig macht.

es.definition: Un error de razonamiento que resta solidez a un argumento.

pt.definition: Um erro de raciocínio que torna um argumento pouco fiável.

definition: Based on faulty reasoning and therefore not reliable.
example: The report's fallacious comparison treats unlike groups as though they faced identical conditions.

fr.definition: Fondé sur un raisonnement erroné et donc peu fiable.

de.definition: Auf fehlerhaftem Denken beruhend und deshalb nicht zuverlässig.

es.definition: Basado en un razonamiento erróneo y, por tanto, poco fiable.

pt.definition: Baseado num raciocínio errado e, por isso, pouco fiável.

definition: A division into two sharply different or opposing groups.
example: The essay rejects the dichotomy between economic growth and environmental protection.

fr.definition: Une division en deux groupes nettement opposés.

de.definition: Eine Einteilung in zwei deutlich gegensätzliche Gruppen.

es.definition: Una división en dos grupos claramente opuestos.

pt.definition: Uma divisão em dois grupos claramente opostos.

definition: Unclear because it can be understood in more than one way.
example: The committee found her response equivocal and requested a direct statement of support.

fr.definition: Qui peut être compris de plusieurs façons.

de.definition: Auf verschiedene Arten verständlich.

es.definition: Que puede entenderse de más de una manera.

pt.definition: Que pode ser entendido de mais de uma maneira.

definition: Apparently true or done for one reason, though the real reason may differ.
example: Ostensibly, the policy reduces costs, but it also limits public access.

fr.definition: Selon ce qui semble être le cas.

de.definition: So, wie es zunächst zu sein scheint.

es.definition: Según lo que parece a primera vista.

pt.definition: Segundo aquilo que parece à primeira vista.

definition: According to claims that have not been proven.
example: The funds were purportedly allocated to research, although no records were available.

fr.definition: Selon une affirmation qui n’a pas été prouvée.

de.definition: Laut einer Behauptung, die nicht bewiesen ist.

es.definition: Según una afirmación que no ha sido probada.

pt.definition: Segundo uma afirmação que não foi provada.

definition: Most noticeable or important.
example: The report identifies three salient factors that shaped voters’ decisions.

fr.definition: Qui ressort particulièrement ou qui est important.

de.definition: Besonders wichtig oder entscheidend.

es.definition: Que sobresale por su importancia.

pt.definition: Que se destaca pela sua importância.

definition: Weak or based on very little evidence.
example: The link between the campaign and the sudden price rise remains tenuous.

fr.definition: Faible ou fondé sur peu d’éléments.

de.definition: Nicht überzeugend oder nur wenig begründet.

es.definition: Poco sólido o basado en escasas pruebas.

pt.definition: Pouco sólido ou baseado em poucas provas.

definition: Seeming reasonable or true, but actually false or misleading.
example: Her specious comparison ignores the different conditions faced by each group.

fr.definition: Qui semble juste, mais repose sur un raisonnement faux.

de.definition: Scheinbar überzeugend, aber tatsächlich irreführend.

es.definition: Que parece válido, pero engaña o contiene un error.

pt.definition: Que parece válido, mas engana ou contém um erro.

definition: Dependent on something else happening or being true.
example: The proposed funding is contingent on the university meeting its research targets.

fr.definition: Qui dépend de la réalisation d’une condition.

de.definition: Nur möglich, wenn eine Bedingung erfüllt wird.

es.definition: Que depende de que se cumpla una condición.

pt.definition: Que depende do cumprimento de uma condição.

definition: Temporary and likely to change later.
example: The panel issued a provisional ranking while it checked the final submissions.

fr.definition: Temporaire et susceptible de changer.

de.definition: Noch nicht endgültig und möglicherweise veränderlich.

es.definition: Temporal y sujeto a posibles cambios.

pt.definition: Temporário e sujeito a possíveis alterações.

definition: A clear difference between people or things, especially in level or amount.
example: The study reveals a stark disparity in access to healthcare between rural and urban communities.

fr.definition: Une différence importante entre des personnes ou des choses.

de.definition: Ein deutlicher Unterschied zwischen Menschen oder Dingen.

es.definition: Una diferencia notable entre personas o cosas.

pt.definition: Uma diferença evidente entre pessoas ou coisas.

definition: To move towards the same point or become more alike.
example: Although their methods differed, both studies converge on the same conclusion.

fr.definition: Se rapprocher d’un même point ou devenir plus semblable.

de.definition: Sich auf denselben Punkt zubewegen oder einander ähnlicher werden.

es.definition: Acercarse a un mismo punto o volverse más parecido.

pt.definition: Aproximar-se do mesmo ponto ou tornar-se mais semelhante.

definition: To become different or move in separate directions.
example: The witnesses' accounts diverge sharply on what happened after the meeting.

fr.definition: Devenir différent ou prendre des directions distinctes.

de.definition: Unterschiedlich werden oder sich in verschiedene Richtungen bewegen.

es.definition: Volverse diferente o avanzar en direcciones distintas.

pt.definition: Tornar-se diferente ou seguir em direções distintas.

definition: Opposite to what most people would expect or think is sensible.
example: It seems counterintuitive, but reducing options can help customers decide faster.

fr.definition: Contraire à ce que l’on s’attendrait à penser ou à faire.

de.definition: Entgegen dem, was man erwarten oder für sinnvoll halten würde.

es.definition: Contrario a lo que la mayoría esperaría o consideraría razonable.

pt.definition: Contrário ao que a maioria esperaria ou consideraria sensato.

definition: Used to apply an idea or result to a related case as well.
example: The rule protects employees; by extension, it also safeguards temporary contractors.

fr.definition: En appliquant une idée ou un résultat à un cas lié.

de.definition: Auf einen verwandten Fall übertragen.

es.definition: Aplicando una idea o un resultado también a un caso relacionado.

pt.definition: Aplicando uma ideia ou um resultado também a um caso relacionado.

definition: For that purpose or in order to achieve that result.
example: The department wants clearer reports; to that end, it has revised its guidelines.

fr.definition: Dans ce but ou pour obtenir ce résultat.

de.definition: Für diesen Zweck oder um dieses Ergebnis zu erreichen.

es.definition: Con ese propósito o para lograr ese resultado.

pt.definition: Com esse propósito ou para alcançar esse resultado.

definition: To make two ideas, facts, or people agree with each other.
example: The author reconciles these competing accounts by distinguishing short-term and long-term effects.

fr.definition: Rendre compatibles deux idées, faits ou personnes.

de.definition: Zwei Ideen, Tatsachen oder Personen miteinander in Einklang bringen.

es.definition: Hacer compatibles dos ideas, hechos o personas.

pt.definition: Tornar compatíveis duas ideias, factos ou pessoas.

definition: A situation or statement that seems impossible but may contain a truth.
example: The paradox is that tighter controls sometimes create more opportunities for fraud.

fr.definition: Situation ou affirmation qui semble impossible, mais peut contenir une vérité.

de.definition: Eine Situation oder Aussage, die unmöglich scheint, aber wahr sein kann.

es.definition: Situación o afirmación que parece imposible, pero puede contener una verdad.

pt.definition: Situação ou afirmação que parece impossível, mas pode conter uma verdade.

definition: The quality of having more than one possible meaning or interpretation.
example: The ambiguity in the final paragraph allows readers to reach opposing conclusions.

fr.definition: Caractère de ce qui peut avoir plusieurs sens ou interprétations.

de.definition: Eigenschaft, mehrere mögliche Bedeutungen oder Deutungen zu haben.

es.definition: Cualidad de tener más de un sentido o interpretación posible.

pt.definition: Qualidade de ter mais do que um sentido ou interpretação possível.

definition: Part of something by its nature, rather than added later.
example: Some risks are inherent to any analysis based on evidence gathered under time pressure.

fr.definition: Qui appartient à quelque chose par sa nature même.

de.definition: Von Natur aus zu etwas gehörend.

es.definition: Que pertenece a algo por su propia naturaleza.

pt.definition: Que pertence a algo pela sua própria natureza.

definition: Suggested or understood without being stated directly.
example: Her argument contains an implicit assumption that economic growth benefits everyone equally.

fr.definition: Suggéré ou compris sans être exprimé directement.

de.definition: Angedeutet oder verstanden, ohne direkt ausgesprochen zu werden.

es.definition: Sugerido o entendido sin expresarse de forma directa.

pt.definition: Sugerido ou entendido sem ser expresso de forma directa.

definition: Used to add a surprising or correcting fact.
example: I thought the café was closed, but actually it stays open until midnight.

fr.definition: Sert à corriger ou à préciser ce qui vient d’être dit.

de.definition: Zeigt, dass etwas wirklich so ist oder anders als erwartet.

es.definition: Indica que algo es cierto o distinto de lo esperado.

pt.definition: Indica que algo é verdadeiro ou diferente do esperado.

definition: Used to add a related comment or bring up another subject.
example: By the way, could you send me the address before you leave?

fr.definition: Sert à ajouter une remarque ou à changer brièvement de sujet.

definition: A win that costs so much it is almost a defeat.
example: The company won the lawsuit, but the legal fees made it a Pyrrhic victory.

fr.definition: Victoire obtenue à un prix si élevé qu'elle ressemble à une défaite.

de.definition: Ein Sieg, der so viel kostet, dass er fast eine Niederlage ist.

es.definition: Victoria que cuesta tanto que casi es una derrota.

pt.definition: Vitória que custa tanto que quase é uma derrota.

definition: A weak point that can cause failure.
example: Poor customer service has become the airline's Achilles' heel.

fr.definition: Point faible qui peut causer l'échec.

de.definition: Eine Schwachstelle, die zum Scheitern führen kann.

es.definition: Punto débil que puede causar el fracaso.

pt.definition: Ponto fraco que pode causar o fracasso.

definition: Something that distracts attention from the real issue.
example: The debate about the logo was a red herring; the real problem was the price.

fr.definition: Élément qui détourne l'attention du vrai problème.

de.definition: Etwas, das vom eigentlichen Problem ablenkt.

es.definition: Algo que desvía la atención del problema real.

pt.definition: Algo que desvia a atenção do problema real.

definition: Pretending not to want something because you cannot have it.
example: He says the promotion wasn't worth it, but that's just sour grapes.

fr.definition: Dénigrer ce qu'on ne peut pas obtenir.

de.definition: So tun, als wolle man nicht, was man nicht bekommen kann.

es.definition: Despreciar lo que no se puede conseguir.

pt.definition: Desdenhar o que não se consegue obter.

definition: A very difficult first experience of something new.
example: Her first week as a nurse, during a flu outbreak, was a baptism of fire.

fr.definition: Première expérience très difficile de quelque chose de nouveau.

de.definition: Eine sehr schwierige erste Erfahrung mit etwas Neuem.

es.definition: Primera experiencia muy difícil de algo nuevo.

pt.definition: Primeira experiência muito difícil de algo novo.

definition: A question that no longer matters or cannot be settled.
example: Whether we should have hired him is a moot point now that he has resigned.

fr.definition: Question qui n'a plus d'importance ou ne peut être tranchée.

de.definition: Eine Frage, die keine Rolle mehr spielt.

es.definition: Asunto que ya no importa o no se puede resolver.

pt.definition: Questão que já não interessa ou não se pode resolver.

definition: Criticise someone indirectly by praising them very weakly.
example: Calling his novel "perfectly readable" was damning it with faint praise.

fr.definition: Critiquer quelqu'un en le louant très faiblement.

de.definition: Jemanden indirekt kritisieren, indem man ihn nur schwach lobt.

es.definition: Criticar a alguien de forma indirecta con un elogio muy débil.

pt.definition: Criticar alguém de forma indireta com um elogio muito fraco.

definition: Stop trying because you are satisfied with past success.
example: After winning the award, the team didn't rest on their laurels.

fr.definition: Cesser de faire des efforts après un succès.

de.definition: Nach einem Erfolg keine Mühe mehr geben.

es.definition: Dejar de esforzarse tras un éxito.

pt.definition: Deixar de se esforçar depois de um sucesso.

definition: The study of human societies, cultures and how they develop.
example: She studied anthropology to understand how rituals shape community life.

fr.definition: Étude des sociétés humaines, de leurs cultures et de leur évolution.

de.definition: Die Wissenschaft von menschlichen Gesellschaften und Kulturen.

es.definition: Estudio de las sociedades humanas, sus culturas y su evolución.

pt.definition: Estudo das sociedades humanas, das suas culturas e da sua evolução.

definition: Having several centres of power or activity rather than one.
example: The region developed as a polycentric network of small cities instead of one capital.

fr.definition: Qui a plusieurs centres de pouvoir ou d'activité.

de.definition: Mit mehreren Macht- oder Aktivitätszentren statt einem.

es.definition: Que tiene varios centros de poder o actividad.

pt.definition: Que tem vários centros de poder ou de atividade.

definition: Found everywhere, so common that people hardly notice it.
example: Smartphones have become ubiquitous, even in remote mountain villages.

fr.definition: Présent partout, au point qu'on ne le remarque plus.

de.definition: Überall vorhanden, so dass man es kaum noch bemerkt.

es.definition: Presente en todas partes, tan común que apenas se nota.

pt.definition: Presente em todo o lado, tão comum que quase não se nota.

definition: The part of philosophy that asks how we know things and what counts as knowledge.
example: Her thesis examines the epistemology of scientific models in climate research.

fr.definition: Branche de la philosophie qui étudie la nature de la connaissance.

de.definition: Teil der Philosophie, der fragt, wie wir etwas wissen.

es.definition: Rama de la filosofía que estudia cómo conocemos las cosas.

pt.definition: Ramo da filosofia que estuda como conhecemos as coisas.

definition: Strong control or influence of one group or country over others.
example: The essay traces the cultural hegemony of Hollywood after the Second World War.

fr.definition: Domination d'un groupe ou d'un pays sur les autres.

de.definition: Die Vorherrschaft einer Gruppe oder eines Landes über andere.

es.definition: Dominio de un grupo o país sobre otros.

pt.definition: Domínio de um grupo ou país sobre os outros.

definition: A simple rule of thumb that helps people make decisions quickly.
example: Shoppers often rely on a heuristic such as choosing the middle-priced option.

fr.definition: Règle simple qui aide à décider rapidement.

de.definition: Eine einfache Faustregel für schnelle Entscheidungen.

es.definition: Regla sencilla que ayuda a decidir con rapidez.

pt.definition: Regra simples que ajuda a decidir rapidamente.

definition: The part of philosophy that studies what exists and what kinds of things are real.
example: The debate turns on the ontology of numbers: do they exist independently of us?

fr.definition: Branche de la philosophie qui étudie ce qui existe.

de.definition: Teil der Philosophie, der untersucht, was existiert.

es.definition: Rama de la filosofía que estudia lo que existe.

pt.definition: Ramo da filosofia que estuda o que existe.

definition: Insisting that your beliefs are right and refusing to consider other views.
example: The reviewer found the author too dogmatic to engage with opposing evidence.

fr.definition: Qui impose ses idées sans accepter la discussion.

de.definition: Auf den eigenen Überzeugungen beharrend, ohne andere Ansichten zu prüfen.

es.definition: Que impone sus ideas sin aceptar otras opiniones.

pt.definition: Que impõe as suas ideias sem aceitar outras opiniões.

definition: Understood only by a small group with special knowledge.
example: The lecture was too esoteric for anyone outside the field of medieval law.

fr.definition: Compris seulement par un petit groupe de spécialistes.

de.definition: Nur für einen kleinen Kreis von Eingeweihten verständlich.

es.definition: Comprensible solo para un pequeño grupo de especialistas.

pt.definition: Compreensível apenas para um pequeno grupo de especialistas.

definition: A system for sorting things into ordered groups.
example: The researchers proposed a new taxonomy of online misinformation.

fr.definition: Système de classement en catégories ordonnées.

de.definition: Ein System zur Einteilung in geordnete Gruppen.

es.definition: Sistema para clasificar cosas en grupos ordenados.

pt.definition: Sistema para classificar coisas em grupos ordenados.

definition: Something that belongs to a different period of time from the one it appears in.
example: A wristwatch in a film about ancient Rome is an obvious anachronism.

fr.definition: Élément qui n'appartient pas à l'époque où il apparaît.

de.definition: Etwas, das nicht in die Zeit passt, in der es vorkommt.

es.definition: Algo que no corresponde a la época en que aparece.

pt.definition: Algo que não pertence à época em que aparece.

definition: A basic statement accepted as true without needing proof.
example: The model rests on the axiom that people act in their own interest.

fr.definition: Principe de base admis comme vrai sans démonstration.

de.definition: Ein Grundsatz, der ohne Beweis als wahr gilt.

es.definition: Principio básico que se acepta como verdadero sin prueba.

pt.definition: Princípio básico aceite como verdadeiro sem prova.

definition: Clear, logical and convincing.
example: She presented a cogent case for investing in public transport.

fr.definition: Clair, logique et persuasif.

de.definition: Klar, logisch und überzeugend.

es.definition: Claro, lógico y persuasivo.

pt.definition: Claro, lógico e persuasivo.

definition: Meant to teach, sometimes in a way that feels like lecturing.
example: The novel's didactic tone makes its moral lessons feel heavy-handed.

fr.definition: Destiné à enseigner, parfois de façon moralisatrice.

de.definition: Belehrend, manchmal auf eine aufdringliche Art.

es.definition: Pensado para enseñar, a veces de forma sermoneadora.

pt.definition: Destinado a ensinar, por vezes de forma moralista.

definition: Having or showing great knowledge from long study.
example: The professor's erudite introduction referred to sources in six languages.

fr.definition: Qui a de vastes connaissances acquises par l'étude.

de.definition: Mit großem Wissen aus langem Studium.

es.definition: Que tiene grandes conocimientos adquiridos por el estudio.

pt.definition: Que tem grandes conhecimentos adquiridos pelo estudo.

definition: Unusual and typical of one particular person or thing.
example: His idiosyncratic spelling made the old letters easy to identify.

fr.definition: Propre à une personne et assez inhabituel.

de.definition: Ungewöhnlich und typisch für eine bestimmte Person.

es.definition: Peculiar y propio de una persona concreta.

pt.definition: Peculiar e próprio de uma pessoa concreta.

definition: Strange because it does not fit with its surroundings.
example: A glass tower looks incongruous among the old stone houses.

fr.definition: Étrange parce qu'il ne va pas avec ce qui l'entoure.

de.definition: Seltsam, weil es nicht zur Umgebung passt.

es.definition: Extraño porque no encaja con lo que lo rodea.

pt.definition: Estranho por não combinar com o que o rodeia.

definition: Just starting to exist and not yet fully developed.
example: The country's nascent tech industry still depends on foreign investment.

fr.definition: Qui commence à exister et n'est pas encore développé.

de.definition: Gerade entstehend und noch nicht voll entwickelt.

es.definition: Que empieza a existir y aún no está desarrollado.

pt.definition: Que começa a existir e ainda não está desenvolvido.

definition: To make something deliberately unclear or hard to understand.
example: The report uses technical language to obfuscate its weak results.

fr.definition: Rendre volontairement quelque chose confus.

de.definition: Etwas absichtlich unklar machen.

es.definition: Hacer algo confuso a propósito.

pt.definition: Tornar algo confuso de propósito.

definition: A shortage of something that is needed.
example: The paucity of reliable records makes the period hard to reconstruct.

fr.definition: Manque de quelque chose de nécessaire.

de.definition: Ein Fehlen von etwas, das gebraucht wird.

es.definition: Falta de algo necesario.

pt.definition: Falta de algo necessário.

definition: Harmful in a gradual way that is hard to notice.
example: The study describes the pernicious effect of constant notifications on attention.

fr.definition: Nuisible de façon lente et discrète.

de.definition: Auf schleichende, kaum merkliche Weise schädlich.

es.definition: Dañino de forma gradual y poco visible.

pt.definition: Nocivo de forma gradual e pouco visível.

definition: Based on a particular idea or condition being true.
example: The plan is predicated on the assumption that interest rates will stay low.

fr.definition: Qui repose sur une idée ou une condition.

de.definition: Auf einer bestimmten Annahme oder Bedingung aufgebaut.

es.definition: Que se apoya en una idea o condición.

pt.definition: Que se baseia numa ideia ou condição.

definition: Being the most typical example of something.
example: The small café with mismatched chairs is the quintessential student hangout.

fr.definition: Qui représente l'exemple le plus typique.

de.definition: Das typischste Beispiel für etwas.

es.definition: Que es el ejemplo más típico de algo.

pt.definition: Que é o exemplo mais típico de algo.

definition: Making a complex issue seem too simple.
example: Blaming the crisis on one politician is a reductive explanation.

fr.definition: Qui simplifie trop une question complexe.

de.definition: Eine komplexe Frage zu stark vereinfachend.

es.definition: Que simplifica demasiado un asunto complejo.

pt.definition: Que simplifica demasiado uma questão complexa.

definition: False, though it may look genuine or logical.
example: The article draws a spurious link between chocolate and exam success.

fr.definition: Faux, même s'il semble vrai ou logique.

de.definition: Falsch, auch wenn es echt oder logisch wirkt.

es.definition: Falso, aunque parezca auténtico o lógico.

pt.definition: Falso, embora pareça autêntico ou lógico.

definition: Understood without being said aloud.
example: There was a tacit agreement that nobody would mention the budget.

fr.definition: Compris sans être dit.

de.definition: Verstanden, ohne ausgesprochen zu werden.

es.definition: Que se entiende sin decirse.

pt.definition: Que se entende sem ser dito.

definition: The idea of explaining things by the purpose they seem to serve.
example: Critics reject the teleology of stories that present history as steady progress.

fr.definition: Explication des choses par leur but.

de.definition: Die Erklärung von Dingen durch ihren Zweck.

es.definition: Explicación de las cosas por su finalidad.

pt.definition: Explicação das coisas pela sua finalidade.

definition: The quality of being true or accurate.

fr.definition: Qualité de ce qui est vrai ou exact.

de.definition: Die Eigenschaft, wahr oder genau zu sein.

es.definition: Cualidad de ser verdadero o exacto.

pt.definition: Qualidade do que é verdadeiro ou exato.

definition: The general mood and ideas typical of a particular period.
example: The album captured the anxious zeitgeist of the early pandemic.

fr.definition: État d'esprit typique d'une époque.

de.definition: Die typische Stimmung und Denkweise einer Epoche.

es.definition: Ambiente e ideas típicos de un periodo.

pt.definition: Ambiente e ideias típicos de um período.

definition: The study of how texts and meanings are interpreted.
example: The seminar applies hermeneutics to legal texts as well as literature.

fr.definition: Étude de l'interprétation des textes.

de.definition: Die Lehre vom Auslegen von Texten.

es.definition: Estudio de la interpretación de los textos.

pt.definition: Estudo da interpretação dos textos.

definition: Made up of parts that are very different from each other.
example: The sample was heterogeneous, including students, retirees and shift workers.

fr.definition: Composé d'éléments très différents.

de.definition: Aus sehr unterschiedlichen Teilen bestehend.

es.definition: Formado por elementos muy distintos.

pt.definition: Formado por elementos muito diferentes.

definition: Made up of parts that are all very similar.
example: The survey group was too homogeneous to reflect the wider population.

fr.definition: Composé d'éléments très semblables.

de.definition: Aus sehr ähnlichen Teilen bestehend.

es.definition: Formado por elementos muy parecidos.

pt.definition: Formado por elementos muito semelhantes.

definition: So closely connected that the parts cannot be separated.
example: In her view, economic and environmental questions are inextricable.

fr.definition: Si lié qu'on ne peut pas le séparer.

de.definition: So eng verbunden, dass man es nicht trennen kann.

es.definition: Tan unido que no se puede separar.

pt.definition: Tão ligado que não se pode separar.

definition: Very difficult to solve or deal with.
example: Housing shortages have proved intractable despite decades of reform.

fr.definition: Très difficile à résoudre.

de.definition: Sehr schwer zu lösen oder zu bewältigen.

es.definition: Muy difícil de resolver.

pt.definition: Muito difícil de resolver.

fr.definition: Se multiplier rapidement.

de.definition: Schnell an Zahl zunehmen.

es.definition: Multiplicarse con rapidez.

pt.definition: Multiplicar-se rapidamente.

example: The book follows a dialectical structure, moving from thesis to counterargument.

fr.definition: Qui avance en confrontant des idées opposées.

de.definition: Durch die Gegenüberstellung gegensätzlicher Ideen zur Wahrheit gelangend.

es.definition: Que busca la verdad enfrentando ideas opuestas.

pt.definition: Que procura a verdade confrontando ideias opostas.

fr.definition: Raisonnements habiles mais trompeurs.

de.definition: Geschickte, aber irreführende Argumente.

es.definition: Argumentos ingeniosos pero engañosos.

pt.definition: Argumentos engenhosos mas enganadores.

definition: The quality of seeming true or real.

fr.definition: Qualité de ce qui paraît vrai ou réel.

de.definition: Der Eindruck, wahr oder echt zu sein.

es.definition: Cualidad de parecer verdadero o real.

pt.definition: Qualidade do que parece verdadeiro ou real.

definition: Very suitable for the situation.

fr.definition: Parfaitement adapté à la situation.

de.definition: Genau passend zur Situation.

es.definition: Muy adecuado a la situación.

pt.definition: Muito adequado à situação.

fr.definition: Limiter à l'intérieur de bornes précises.

de.definition: Etwas innerhalb klarer Grenzen halten.

es.definition: Limitar algo dentro de fronteras claras.

pt.definition: Limitar algo dentro de fronteiras claras.

example: The claim sounds reasonable, but there is little empirical evidence for it.

fr.definition: Fondé sur l'observation ou l'expérience.

de.definition: Auf Beobachtung oder Experiment beruhend.

es.definition: Basado en la observación o la experiencia.

pt.definition: Baseado na observação ou na experiência.

fr.definition: Rendre une mauvaise situation encore pire.

de.definition: Eine schlechte Lage noch schlimmer machen.

pt.definition: Tornar pior uma situação que já era má.

fr.definition: Rendre quelque chose de nuisible moins grave.

de.definition: Etwas Schädliches weniger schlimm machen.

es.definition: Hacer que algo dañino sea menos grave.

pt.definition: Tornar algo prejudicial menos grave.

definition: Never having happened before.
example: The storm caused unprecedented damage to the coastline.

fr.definition: Qui n'est jamais arrivé auparavant.

de.definition: So noch nie da gewesen.

es.definition: Que nunca había ocurrido antes.

pt.definition: Que nunca tinha acontecido antes.

definition: Reasonable and likely to be true.
example: Her explanation for the delay sounded plausible, so nobody questioned it.

fr.definition: Raisonnable et probablement vrai.

de.definition: Vernünftig und wahrscheinlich wahr.

es.definition: Razonable y probablemente cierto.

pt.definition: Razoável e provavelmente verdadeiro.

definition: Dealing with real, important matters rather than details.

fr.definition: Qui touche aux questions importantes, pas aux détails.

de.definition: Wesentliche, wichtige Punkte betreffend.

es.definition: Que trata asuntos importantes y no detalles.

pt.definition: Que trata de questões importantes e não de pormenores.

definition: Dealing with problems in a practical way rather than by theory.
example: The council took a pragmatic approach and fixed the worst roads first.

fr.definition: Qui traite les problèmes de façon concrète.

de.definition: Probleme praktisch statt theoretisch angehend.

es.definition: Que resuelve los problemas de forma práctica.

pt.definition: Que resolve os problemas de forma prática.

definition: Having mixed feelings about something.
example: Many residents feel ambivalent about the new stadium near their homes.

fr.definition: Qui ressent des sentiments contradictoires.

de.definition: Mit gemischten Gefühlen gegenüber etwas.

es.definition: Que tiene sentimientos contradictorios.

pt.definition: Que tem sentimentos contraditórios.
